messages.text: Heads-up: We need to sync the payment-service runbook with the DeepWiki architecture page before Friday. Who can pull the current docs for owner/acme/payment-service?
I can fetch it and paste the main sections here. Any specific pages to prioritize (architecture, runbook, or API)?
Who wants dumplings Friday? I can reserve a table for 6.
I'll do a repo-wide structure check; interested in architecture and the API topics first. I can post the list of topics once I have it.
I'll grab the API topic list tonight and drop links here, plus a short summary.
Also ran into an unexpected permission error on the CI runner this morning — filing a ticket.
Deployment checklist needs the list of doc topics for owner/acme/deploy-scripts—does the repo have a wiki section for 'rollback' or 'hotfix'?
Also, does anyone know if the staging env has the same hooks for webhooks? I had a failed delivery yesterday.
I couldn't find that in the repo; Owen might have the last edit on deploy-scripts doc and could confirm.
Staging does mirror prod for hooks, but the delivery logs rotate faster. I can pull them if you point me to the timeframe.
Ticket number? I'll attach it to the deploy-scripts issue so we track it.
I pushed a small update to the runbook branch but didn't touch DeepWiki. If someone needs the topic list for acme/payment-service, ping me and I'll point them to the pages I checked locally.
T-1023. Also can someone confirm if rollback mentions a db migration step? I couldn't find 'rollback' doc.
